signature.name: VTask.mmap
signature.type: {m : Type u → Type u_6} -> [Monad m] -> {α : Type u_7} -> {β : Type u} -> (f : α → m β) -> {n : ℕ} -> List.Vector α n → m (List.Vector β n)

conventions.statement: When the input vector has length 0, VTask.mmap f nil = pure nil, and f is never called.
conventions.note: Base case of the recursion; no effects are executed.

conventions.statement: Effects are sequenced head-first: f is applied to xs.head before recursing on xs.tail.
conventions.note: Follows standard monadic do-notation sequencing order.

facts.statement: example : VTask.mmap (some : ℕ → Option ℕ) (List.Vector.nil : List.Vector ℕ 0) = pure List.Vector.nil := by decide

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: example : VTask.mmap (some : ℕ → Option ℕ) (⟨[1], rfl⟩ : List.Vector ℕ 1) = some ⟨[1], rfl⟩ := by decide

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: example : VTask.mmap (fun x => some (x + 1)) (⟨[3, 5], rfl⟩ : List.Vector ℕ 2) = some ⟨[4, 6], rfl⟩ := by decide

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: example : VTask.mmap (fun _ => (none : Option ℕ)) (⟨[1, 2], rfl⟩ : List.Vector ℕ 2) = none := by decide

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type} (f : α → β) {n : ℕ} (v : List.Vector α n), VTask.mmap (fun x => (pure (f x) : Id β)) v = List.Vector.map f v

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: example : VTask.mmap (fun x => some (x * 2)) (⟨[1, 2, 3], rfl⟩ : List.Vector ℕ 3) = some ⟨[2, 4, 6], rfl⟩ := by decide

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.instance: VTask.mmap (fun x => some (x * 2)) (⟨[1, 2, 3], rfl⟩ : List.Vector ℕ 3)

facts.statement: example : VTask.mmap (fun x => if x = 1 then none else some x) (⟨[1, 2], rfl⟩ : List.Vector ℕ 2) = none := by decide

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.instance: VTask.mmap (fun x => if x = 1 then none else some x) (⟨[1, 2], rfl⟩ : List.Vector ℕ 2)
facts.violated_property: f returns none for the first element, so the entire computation returns none

facts.statement: ∀ {α β γ : Type} (f : α → Option β) (g : β → Option γ) {n : ℕ} (v : List.Vector α n), (VTask.mmap f v >>= VTask.mmap g) = VTask.mmap (fun x => f x >>= g) v

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type} (f : α → Option β) {n : ℕ} (v : List.Vector α n), (VTask.mmap f v).map List.Vector.toList = (v.toList.mapM f)
